name: map-fanout
description: The ticket 13.4 canonical dynamic map fan-out workflow (ADR-015). A `map` step fans a runtime list out into one instance of a named sub-template (the `templates` library) per item, plus a generated `gather` join that collects the ordered per-instance results — an engine-generated expansion (no LLM), applied atomically through store.ExpandRun exactly like a planner's. Here `source` emits a three-element list, `process` maps over it (instantiating `analyze_one` as `analyze#0..2`, each an `llm` call on `mock/sim-1` that references its item through the reserved `${{ item }}` / `${{ item_index }}` roots), and the generated gather `process#gather` emits the ordered array of the three analyses. It runs entirely offline on the mock: the mock echoes each prompt, so the gathered array cites each item verbatim. N is capped by `max_items` (and by the run's per-expansion cap); a list longer than the cap fails the map permanently at expansion time. Swap `source` for a `retrieve` and `mock/sim-1` for a real provider and the same shape maps an LLM call over a retrieved list.
